description: The head-count correction does not add support for 51B's linear-replacement attention.
trigger: Construct the inspected Nemotron-51B configuration with assertions enabled and reach block 11.
expected_behavior: Complete 51B compatibility would require implementing its linear-replacement attention blocks.
actual_behavior: DeciLMModel.__init__ still raises the explicit replace_with_linear-not-supported assertion before evaluating that block's null group size. The direct generic constructor caller is Model.from_config; conversion reaches it through get_base_model. No claim is made that all other workflows were inspected.

verification.description: Compared the configuration's block 11 attention flags with the unchanged assertion and inspected generic construction and conversion call sites.
verification.limits: Constructor and checkpoint loading were not executed.
